thread:
Kim (sales-eng): Heads-up — Saffron wants a short performance POC this week. Scope they asked for:
- smoke (10 qps) sanity
- sustained 200 qps for 15m (gen-text, avg 40 tokens)
- 5x microbursts (1m at 1k qps) to validate routing/fallbacks
Also need: KMS/HSM latency profile, and quick pricing compare (reserved vs burst). Who can own infra runbook + security answers? :eyes:

Alyssa (eng): I can take the perf runbook. Quick notes: 200 qps gen-text on our 7B quantized variant (kv-cache warm, batch=8) roughly maps to ~70-90ms p95 per token on A100-like hardware; token count matters a lot. For 40 tokens expect ~3.2s p95 single-call before batching benefits. We'll mitigate with continuous batching + prefix cache.

Matt (infra): For the stress portion I'll provision a canary pool in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Run plan idea:
- smoke: 1 pod, validate routing + auth
- sustained: 6 pods (start), autoscale target based on 95th CPU and latency
- bursts: use transient burst-capacity pool (no local state)

Use this k6 command for the sustained run (simple PoC):
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m --summary-export=report.json saffron_gen_test.js
```
Script should POST to /v1/generate with 40-token prompt and record server-side token/time headers.

Alyssa (eng): Add to that: set header X-Model-Variant: "7b-quant-v2" and include X-Approx-Token-Length so we can correlate cost. Also enable token-level tracing for a sample of requests.

Jordan (security): On KMS/HSM: Saffron asked for HSM-backed keys and attestations. For Hosted we offer CMEK via CloudKMS (auditable, FIPS/HSM options depending on cloud). For Private we can integrate with customer HSM (requires network/NAT rules). Questions for their security team:
- Are they okay with our KMS provider (GCP/Azure/AWS)?
- Do they require attestation docs / FedRAMP / specific CA?

If they need HSM latency numbers I can pull 99th-percentile key unwrap times from previous runs (usually 5-8ms on AWS CloudHSM + network egress). Need to know region.

Ryan (ops): I'll own the orchestration tasks. Proposed checklist:
1) Provision canary pools (us-west-2, eu-west-1)
2) Warm kv caches with ~1k prefix requests
3) Run smoke (10 qps) green check
4) Run sustained (200 qps) with observability hooks (trace sampling=5%)
5) Run bursts and validate fallback to lower-cost variant if saturated

I'll also add autoscale policy: min=2 pods, target CPU=65%, max=20. Cache warming script attached in the repo.

Kim (sales-eng): Pricing ask — Saffron needs a quick back-of-envelope: if sustained 200 qps for 15m (production-like) what ballpark cost should they expect for hosted vs dedicated reserved? Keep it rough for sales deck.

Alyssa (eng): Rough unit economics (very rough):
- Assumptions: 40 tokens per call, 200 qps => 8k tokens/sec => 28.8M tokens/hour.
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go, quantized model): ~$0.000012 per token => ~345 USD / hour for that sustained run (15m slice ~86 USD).
- Dedicated (reserved) amortized: if they buy reserved capacity sized for 200 qps, might be ~180-250 USD / hour equivalent depending on commit. Burst add-on billed separately.
Numbers are high-level — I'll follow up with a spreadsheet.

Matt (infra): One gotcha: microbursts at 1k qps will trigger auto-bursting and likely cold-starts if pool is small. Recommend burst pool pre-warmed or allowed to use burst quota. Also enable fallback to a cheaper 7b-quant-lite variant to preserve latency if saturation occurs.

Jordan (security): Saffron also asked for SCIM/log retention and log redaction (PII). We can redact prompts on ingest if needed but need a signed agreement. I'll draft the security checkbox answers; can we get their SOC2 report?

Kim (sales-eng): Great. Action items (assign):
- Alyssa: produce perf runbook + cost spreadsheet (EOD today)
- Matt: infra provisioning + k6 script (start now)
- Ryan: schedule runs and cache-warm script (tomorrow morning)
- Jordan: security questionnaire draft + KMS latency numbers (today)

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: canary pool provisioning job started for sales/poc/saffron (id: deploy-9843) :rocket:

Alyssa (eng): I'll attach a small CSV with token assumptions and expected p95 numbers after the first smoke. If we see p95 > 5s we lower batch size or switch variant.

Kim (sales-eng): Thanks team. I'll loop in Saffron contacts and propose: smoke tomorrow 10:00 PT, sustained + bursts tomorrow 14:00 PT. Tagging @Jordan for compliance sync before runs. :thumbsup:

Ryan (ops): Confirmed — I'll reserve the windows and post run links.

Matt (infra): K6 script ready in repo: tools/perf/saffron_gen_test.js — will push in 10m.

Jordan (security): On it — will send the questionnaire draft to Kim and cc Saffron sec.

Kim (sales-eng): Perfect. Closing thread — will reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
